item.title: Boys & Girls Clubs of Sonoma Valley to host spring break camps
item.description: Boys & Girls Clubs of Sonoma Valley will host its first-ever Spring Break Specialty Camps for elementary school students this year.

item.title: La Onda Festival returns to Napa for third year, presale begins Friday
item.description: Festivalgoers may sign up to receive a presale code by text message, allowing access to tickets at the lowest available price.

item.title: Charmian and Jack London’s love story, ‘An Intimate Affair’ comes to Sonoma in February
item.description: Lynne Lancaster along with George Meiling and Josh Little will be part of the show, which is inspired by Jack and Charmian London's love story.

item.title: Sonoma County airport finishes 2025 with new record
item.description: Last year brought the departure of Avelo Airlines and the announcement that Southwest Airlines will begin service this spring.

item.title: Sonoma County supervisors grapple with national immigration enforcement debate amid mounting outrage
item.description: Supervisors grappled publicly with the shockwaves unleashed after Alex Pretti's killing and the wider reckoning over Trump's immigration crackdown, which has spurred advocates to press for greater safeguards for local immigrants.

item.title: Sonoma Valley High students get a VR lesson on the Holocaust
item.description: Sonoma Valley Chabad Jewish Center organized Tuesday's event in recognition of Holocaust Remembrance Day, which takes place on Jan. 27, the anniversary of the 1945 liberation of Auschwitz by Soviet troops.

item.title: New carpool lane hours coming to Highway 101 in Sonoma, Marin counties
item.description: The new hours for high occupancy vehicles on Highway 101 in Sonoma and Marin counties are expected to begin next month, reversing course on a highly unpopular shift made in September.

item.title: New charter school to be housed on Prestwood Elementary School campus
item.description: The Sonoma Valley Unified School District Board of Trustees voted 4-0 on Tuesday to house MacArthur Park Charter School during the 2026-27 school year on the campus currently used by Prestwood Elementary, which will be closing at the end of the current academic year.

item.title: Sonoma hires new sustainability coordinator to advance climate goals
item.description: The city of Sonoma has hired a part-time sustainability coordinator, a new role to help advance Sonoma's climate action strategies and put adopted policies into action.

item.title: Students lobby for pride flag support; Sonoma council weighs cold weather shelter gaps, approves budget
item.description: Sonoma Valley High School students urged city leaders on Jan. 26 to support the campus pride flag, which was removed Jan. 16 after David Bell, president of the Sonoma Valley Unified School District's Board of Trustees, instructed the flag to be removed, before ordering it be restored on Jan. 20. The Council also received an update on the mid-year budget, Sonoma Police Department crime statistics and extreme cold weather response planning.
